audience.text: Developers who generate or modify PowerPoint presentations on servers or in build pipelines and need a lightweight, MIT-licensed dependency that operates entirely within the Office Open XML format.

capabilities.text: Create new presentations or load existing .pptx files using Presentation, then modify slides, shapes, and content before saving in PPTX, PPSX, or POTX formats.
capabilities.title: Create and edit presentations

capabilities.text: Insert AutoShapes, PictureFrames, Tables, and Connectors via ShapeCollection methods, with 190 ShapeType values supported and full formatting control.
capabilities.title: Add and format shapes

capabilities.text: Apply character, paragraph, and text frame formatting via PortionFormat, ParagraphFormat, and TextFrameFormat to control font, size, color, alignment, and spacing.
capabilities.title: Format text content

capabilities.text: Enable eight visual effects—outer shadow, inner shadow, glow, soft edge, reflection, blur, preset shadow, and fill overlay—via EffectFormat methods.
capabilities.title: Apply visual effects

capabilities.text: Add threaded comments with authors, timestamps, and positions via CommentAuthor and CommentCollection; manage speaker notes via NotesSlideManager.
capabilities.title: Manage comments and notes

capabilities.text: Embed images from files, byte arrays, or InputStreams via ImageCollection.addImage() and attach them to slides using addPictureFrame().
capabilities.title: Embed images

capabilities.text: Add, insert, remove, and clone slides via SlideCollection methods including addClone(), addEmptySlide(), insertEmptySlide(), and removeAt().
capabilities.title: Clone and manage slides

capabilities.text: Configure core, app, and custom document properties via DocumentProperties including title, author, subject, keywords, and category.
capabilities.title: Set document properties

limitations.text: No support for charts, SmartArt, OLE objects, video, audio, animations, slide transitions, group shapes, hyperlinks, sections, slide backgrounds, themes, or slide size configuration.
Save() only supports PPTX, PPSX, and POTX; all other SaveFormat values raise UnsupportedOperationException with a clear message.
Cloning a master slide via getMasters().addClone() has a known defect: the clone does not persist to the saved package despite the collection size increasing.
Table.mergeCells() requires an XML-backed table and cannot merge cells on tables built without a backing OOXML element.
Text language attributes are not written to the package; PowerPoint applies the authoring machine's default language instead.
Version 26.7.0 lacks secure XML parsing; builds from source are recommended for untrusted input due to potential XXE vulnerabilities.

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side PowerPoint presentation generation and modification without Microsoft Office, COM automation, or native code dependencies.
Preserves unknown XML content during round-trip operations, ensuring no silent data loss when loading and saving presentations.
Provides a pure Java API for manipulating slides, shapes, text, comments, notes, and document properties with full control over formatting and layout.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for Java is a pure Java, open-source library for creating, reading, and editing PowerPoint .pptx presentations without requiring Microsoft Office or native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of XML parts preserved during round-tripping beyond the measured 41-part deck is not specified.
Whether the library supports reading or writing VBA macros is not explicitly stated beyond refusal to write macro-enabled formats.
The behavior of save() with invalid or missing output paths beyond IOException is not detailed.
Whether Table.mergeCells() works with tables created programmatically without XML backing is unclear.
The exact behavior of clone operations on layout slides beyond master slides is not described.
Whether threaded comment replies beyond setParentComment() are fully supported is not detailed.
The handling of embedded fonts or custom font substitution is not described.
Whether the library supports reading or writing digital signatures is not specified.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Run `mvn package` to build the jar, sources jar, javadoc jar, and CycloneDX SBOM; run `mvn test` to execute all unit, integration, and conformance tests.

workflows.name: Continuous integration
workflows.text: CI runs on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS with Java 21 and 25 on every push and pull request using workflows in .github/workflows/.

workflows.name: Release to Maven Central
workflows.text: Releases are published via .github/workflows/maven-central-release.yml and published as org.aspose:aspose-slides-foss:26.7.0.

workflows.name: Create a presentation
workflows.text: Instantiate Presentation, add shapes and formatting, then save to .pptx, .ppsx, or .potx using save(path, format) or save(stream, format).

workflows.name: Add threaded comments
workflows.text: Create CommentAuthor instances, add comments with timestamps and positions via CommentCollection.addComment(), and support replies via setParentComment().

workflows.name: Format text and shapes
workflows.text: Apply solid, gradient, pattern, or picture fills via FillFormat; configure line properties via LineFormat; and enable visual effects via EffectFormat.
